$comment: Behaviour. This file is hot-reloadable: save it and the running agent picks it up at the next safe swap point, with no restart of the app OR the game.

anchors.name: top_bar
anchors.$comment: Anchors are re-located every frame and produce an offset applied to every ROI below. This is what survives a resolution or DPI change. Without one, a windowed-mode resize breaks every region at once.

extractor.$comment: Cheapest extractor there is. Reach for it before OCR whenever a boolean is encoded as a colour.

intents.name: collect_reward
intents.$comment: An intent without a post_condition is a bug, not a shortcut: nothing else can tell the agent whether the world actually changed (ADR-0003).

tree.$comment: The behaviour tree. First child that does not fail wins (ADR-0008).
